parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

💡
brick[brik]n.
A brick is a block of hard clay that is used for building things, such as walls.
Ý Nghĩa: viên gạch
👉 There were several bricks scattered on the ground.
💡
crumble[krAmbl]v.
To crumble means to break or fall apart into small pieces.
Ý Nghĩa: vỡ vụn, sụp đổ
👉 The old house's walls crumbled into a pile of rock and wood.
💡
dough[dou]n.
Dough is a mixture of flour and water that becomes bread when baked.
Ý Nghĩa: bột nhào
👉 I made heart-shaped cookies from the dough.
💡
express[ikspres]v.
To express a feeling or idea means to show others how one thinks or feels.
Ý Nghĩa: bày tỏ, biểu lộ
👉 The nurse expressed her sympathy for the sick patient.
💡
fist[fist]n.
A fist is a hand with fingers bent in toward the palm.
Ý Nghĩa: nắm đấm
👉 The bully made a fist and threatened to hit the small boy.
💡
flexible[fleksabal]adj.
If something is flexible, then it can bend easily without breaking.
Ý Nghĩa: linh hoạt, dẻo dai
👉 The tree branch was so flexible it could be bent into a circle and not break.
💡
flush[flʌʃ]v.
To flush means the face becomes red due to heat, illness, or emotion.
Ý Nghĩa: đỏ mặt
👉 After the long race, the runner's face was flushed.
💡
injure[indʒər]v.
To injure someone means to damage a part of their body.
Ý Nghĩa: làm bị thương
👉 The car crash injured two people.
💡
lump[lAmp]n.
A lump is a small piece of something that is solid.
Ý Nghĩa: cục, tảng
👉 The artist took a lump of clay and turned it into a beautiful pot.
💡
mixture[mikstʃər]n.
A mixture is something that is made by mixing other things together.
Ý Nghĩa: hỗn hợp
👉 The walls were built using a mixture of water, rock, and dirt.
💡
reconcile[rekansail]v.
To reconcile means to return to a friendly relationship.
Ý Nghĩa: hòa giải
👉 After arguing, the two friends were reconciled with each other.
💡
ruin[ru:in]v.
To ruin something means to harm or damage it greatly.
Ý Nghĩa: phá hỏng
👉 Our walk in the park was ruined by the sudden rain.
💡
shatter[ʃætər]v.
To shatter something means to break it suddenly into many tiny pieces.
Ý Nghĩa: vỡ tan tành
👉 When the ball hit the window, the glass shattered.
💡
shutter[ʃʌtər]n.
Shutters are wooden or metal covers in front of a window.
Ý Nghĩa: cửa chớp
👉 Mr. Smith closed the shutters every night to make his bedroom dark.
💡
sift[sift]v.
To sift something means to remove all the large pieces.
Ý Nghĩa: rây (bột), sàng lọc
👉 The baker sifted the flour into a large bowl.
💡
slight[slait]adj.
If something is slight, then it is small or minor.
Ý Nghĩa: nhẹ, mỏng manh
👉 There was only a slight change in the little boy's height.
💡
sparkle[sparkal]v.
To sparkle means to shine brightly with quick flashes of light.
Ý Nghĩa: lấp lánh
👉 The stars sparkled in the winter night's sky.
💡
sprinkle[sprirjkal]v.
To sprinkle means to scatter something all over something else.
Ý Nghĩa: rắc, rải
👉 He sprinkled the pasta with salt and black pepper.
💡
stale[steil]adj.
If food is stale, then it is not fresh but dry, hard, and not good to eat.
Ý Nghĩa: ôi thiu, cũ
👉 The cookies sat on the table so long that became stale.
💡
utter[ʌtər]v.
To utter a word or a sound means to say it.
Ý Nghĩa: thốt ra, nói ra
👉 The lost boy was so scared that he could barely utter a single word.

sections.title: Exercise 1: Choose the right definition for the given word.

questions.content: ruin
questions.explanation: ruin nghĩa là phá hỏng (to damage).

questions.content: brick
questions.explanation: brick nghĩa là viên gạch (a hard piece of clay).

questions.content: sprinkle
questions.explanation: sprinkle nghĩa là rắc, rải (to scatter).

questions.content: injure
questions.explanation: injure nghĩa là làm bị thương (to hurt).

questions.content: slight
questions.explanation: slight nghĩa là nhẹ, nhỏ nhặt (minor).

sections.title: Exercise 2: Choose the answer that best fits the question.

questions.content: How would a man show others an emotion?
questions.explanation: express nghĩa là bày tỏ, biểu lộ cảm xúc (show emotion).

questions.content: Which of the following says that two former enemies become friends again?
questions.explanation: reconcile nghĩa là hòa giải (become friends again).

questions.content: How would you describe a girl who can stretch her leg behind her head?
questions.explanation: flexible nghĩa là linh hoạt, dẻo dai (stretch easily).

questions.content: Which of these would you use to make bread?
questions.explanation: dough nghĩa là bột nhào, dùng để làm bánh mì.

questions.content: Which word describes something usually found on windows?
questions.explanation: shutters nghĩa là cửa chớp, thường ở trên cửa sổ.

sections.title: Exercise 3: Choose the word that is the better fit for each blank.

questions.content: Before the project, the clay was one big __________. But when he was finished, he made a perfectly square __________.
questions.explanation: lump: cục, tảng; brick: viên gạch. Đất sét lúc đầu là một cục lớn (lump), sau đó anh ấy làm thành một viên gạch vuông vức (brick).

questions.content: Five minutes ago, the two senators were ___________ insults at each other, but now they have ___________ because they both agree with the new law.
questions.explanation: uttering: thốt ra (lời lăng mạ); reconciled: hòa giải. Năm phút trước họ buông lời xúc phạm nhau, giờ họ đã hòa giải.

questions.content: In the middle of the night, she got out of bed and opened the __________. She gazed at the sky where the stars __________ like tiny fires.
questions.explanation: shutters: cửa chớp; sparkled: lấp lánh. Mở cửa chớp (shutters) để ngắm sao lấp lánh (sparkled).

questions.content: The rice was not eaten soon enough, so it tasted __________. It made me feel sick and my face became __________.
questions.explanation: stale: ôi thiu; flushed: đỏ mặt. Cơm cũ ôi thiu (stale) làm tôi ốm và đỏ bừng mặt (flushed).

questions.content: The cook picked up the block of cheese and ___________ it into little pieces. Then he mixed them with the __________ before placing it in the oven.
questions.explanation: crumbled: bóp vụn; dough: bột nhào. Phô mai bị bóp vụn (crumbled) và trộn với bột nhào (dough).

questions.content: When he started to ___________ the flour into the bowl, he slipped and dropped it. The bowl hit the ground and __________.
questions.explanation: sift: rây bột; shattered: vỡ tan tành. Rây bột (sift), rơi bát làm nó vỡ tan tành (shattered).

questions.content: He hit the punching bag with his __________. Since the bag was ___________, it did not break.
questions.explanation: fist: nắm đấm; flexible: linh hoạt. Đánh bằng nắm đấm (fist) vào bao cát dẻo dai (flexible).

questions.content: The __________ of ice cream and chocolate tastes good, but it will be even better if you __________ sugar on the top of it.
questions.explanation: mixture: hỗn hợp; sprinkle: rắc. Hỗn hợp (mixture) kem và socola sẽ ngon hơn nếu rắc (sprinkle) thêm đường.

questions.content: The doctor ___________ a lot of concern for my hurt ankle, but I told him the pain was only __________.
questions.explanation: expressed: bày tỏ; slight: nhẹ. Bác sĩ bày tỏ (expressed) sự lo lắng nhưng cơn đau chỉ rất nhẹ (slight).

questions.content: The ship was ___________ when it crashed into the island. Even though it was greatly damaged, none of the passengers were __________.
questions.explanation: ruined: bị phá hỏng; injured: bị thương. Con tàu bị hỏng nặng (ruined) nhưng hành khách không ai bị thương (injured).

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
The Brothers and the Bread

Two brothers wanted to go outside and play. However, because the only bread in the house was stale, their mother told them they needed to bake fresh bread.

"I have to have the car repaired," she said. "When I return, if the bread is ready, you can play."

The brothers hurried to prepare the bread, but not carefully. They didn't sift the flour. They were careless and sprinkled too much salt into the mixture. The dough needed to be soft and flexible, but the salt made it into a lump that was as hard as a brick.

The younger brother uttered a sigh. "Now we have to start again," he said.

"No, we don't," the older brother replied. "I'll fix it. I just need to make the dough flat again and add water to it."

He decided to hit the ball of dough with his fist to make it flat. But he hit it so hard that it flew right off of the table and knocked over a glass, which shattered. The dough then crashed into the kitchen window's shutters and crumbled. Luckily, the brothers were not injured, but they did make a huge mess.

A slight mistake now became a major problem. The brothers had ruined the kitchen. Just then their mother returned. She saw the mess and became flushed with anger.

"Now you can't play," she said. "Instead, you have to clean the kitchen. I want this kitchen to be so clean that it may sparkle!"

The brothers cleaned the floor and expressed their sorrow to their mother. Soon, they were reconciled. But there was no bread, and it was too late to play. They realized that trying to do something quickly often makes more work.

sections.title: Reading Comprehension Part A: Mark each statement T for true or F for false. Rewrite the false statements to make them true.

questions.content: Because the bread was stale, the mother wanted them to bake fresh bread.
questions.explanation: Câu này đúng. Người mẹ yêu cầu hai anh em nướng bánh mới vì bánh mì trong nhà đã bị ôi thiu. Bằng chứng trong bài là: however, because the only bread in the house was stale, their mother told them they needed to bake fresh bread.

questions.content: The dough became a lump that was as hard as a brick.
questions.explanation: Câu này cũng hoàn toàn chính xác. Lượng muối quá nhiều đã khiến bột nhào biến thành một tảng cứng như đá. Đoạn văn ghi rõ: the salt made it into a lump that was as hard as a brick.

questions.content: The bread needed to be hard and sturdy.
questions.explanation: Câu này sai nhé. Theo bài đọc, bột bánh đáng lẽ ra phải mềm và dẻo dai chứ không phải cứng nhắc. Câu văn chứng minh là: The dough needed to be soft and flexible.

questions.content: The older brother uttered a sigh.
questions.explanation: Câu này sai rồi. Thực ra người em trai mới là người buông tiếng thở dài, chứ không phải người anh. Trích đoạn trong bài viết: The younger brother uttered a sigh.

questions.content: The brothers had to clean the kitchen, so it may sparkle.
questions.explanation: Câu này đúng. Do làm rối tung mọi thứ, người mẹ đã bắt họ phải dọn dẹp nhà bếp sạch sẽ đến mức sáng bóng. Bằng chứng là lời mẹ nói: I want this kitchen to be so clean that it may sparkle!

questions.content: A major mistake only caused a slight problem.
questions.explanation: Câu này sai. Bài đọc nói ngược lại, một sai lầm nhỏ bé đã dẫn đến một vấn đề lớn. Tác giả có viết: A slight mistake now became a major problem.

sections.title: Reading Comprehension Part B: Answer the questions.

questions.content: What made the dough into a hard lump?
questions.explanation: Nguyên nhân khiến khối bột trở nên cứng ngắc chính là việc cho quá nhiều muối. Trong bài có ghi: They were careless and sprinkled too much salt into the mixture... the salt made it into a lump that was as hard as a brick. Do đó đáp án B là chính xác nhất.

questions.content: What happened when the older brother hit the dough with his fist?
questions.explanation: Khi người anh đập tay vào khối bột, nó bay đi và làm rơi vỡ một chiếc cốc. Câu văn chứng minh là: he hit it so hard that it flew right off of the table and knocked over a glass, which shattered. Nên chọn đáp án B.

questions.content: Why was the mother flushed with anger?
questions.explanation: Người mẹ đỏ bừng mặt tức giận vì hai anh em đã phá hỏng hoàn toàn khu bếp. Trích đoạn: The brothers had ruined the kitchen. Just then their mother returned. She saw the mess and became flushed with anger. Vậy nên đáp án B là đúng.

questions.content: When were the brothers reconciled with their mother?
options: When she returned from the store
questions.explanation: Hai anh em đã làm hòa với mẹ sau khi lau dọn sàn nhà và nói lời xin lỗi. Bằng chứng trong bài là: The brothers cleaned the floor and expressed their sorrow to their mother. Soon, they were reconciled. Vì thế đáp án D là sự lựa chọn hợp lý nhất.
